output_contract.overwrite_policy: refuse before input reads or runtime initialization if summary, table, or result root already exists

artificial_cut_boundary_bracket.historical_seed_projection: measure and zero the 6,600 newly constrained vertices; enforce exact zero on all 6,980 cut-incident vertices
artificial_cut_boundary_bracket.interpretation: boundary-condition sensitivity bracket only; it is not an anatomical boundary claim or an inverse-eligibility gate

artificial_cut.policy: intentional full-boundary diagnostic; never admitted to the IsFace membrane ROI

historical_full_skin.role: pinned historical full extracted-boundary topology for the domain-by-conversion causal control

isface_roi_derivation.global_point_id_mapping: explicit arange(n_points), matching ModelBuilder fallback and the pinned historical result
isface_roi_derivation.selection: exact source cell_data IsFaceTriangle, then compact only the referenced points without changing triangle orientation

prepared_volume.role: pinned rest points, tetrahedral connectivity, and point order

topology_provenance.runtime_gate: both domains recompute canonical sorted GlobalPointId triangle digests, exact area, component count, and mesh-coordinate mapping

visual_review.available_inputs: each forward writes a full result.vtu with rest points, target, displacement, and the exact transferred activation
visual_review.required_follow_up: run a separately reviewed static matched-view analyzer before approving an inverse; this entrypoint does not silently import the inverse-screen analyzer or claim visual acceptance
